description: This file defines the AdhocFilter class used for managing filter conditions in the Superset frontend, including methods for validation, duplication, and SQL translation. It also includes utility functions for type conversion and type guarding.

classes.name: AdhocFilter
classes.description: Represents a filter condition with methods for validation, duplication, and SQL translation.

methods.name: duplicateWith
methods.description: Creates a new AdhocFilter instance with updated fields.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if another AdhocFilter is equivalent to this one.

methods.name: getDefaultLabel
methods.description: Returns a label for the filter, truncated if too long.

methods.name: getTooltipTitle
methods.description: Returns the SQL representation of the filter for tooltip display.

methods.name: translateToSql
methods.description: Converts the filter to its SQL string representation.
